Message.Name: Market Participant Quote Update Message
Message.Description: The following message format will be used to disseminate the best-priced quotation for all OTCBB quoting participants and the Inside Quote in each issue

Field.Name: OTCBB Symbol
Field.Description: This alphanumeric field indicates the issue symbol for the OTCBB security being quoted

Field.Name: OTCBB Type
Field.Description: This alphanumeric field indicates if the OTCBB issue being quoted is eligible for real-time or indicative updates

Field.Name: Market Participant Identifier
Field.Description: The Market Participant Identifier (MPID) field indicates the identifier assigned by FINRA to the OTCBB Market Participant that is responsible for generating a quotation message

Field.Name: Market Participant Location ID
Field.Description: The Market Participant Location ID field identifies the branch or trading desk at Market Maker firm or ECN responsible for entering and maintaining quote in the give OTCBB issue

Field.Name: Market Participant Status
Field.Description: This alphanumeric field indicates the current status for the Market Participant position for the issue

Field.Name: Market Participant Quote Condition
Field.Description: The Market Participant Quote Condition field indicates the current quotation state for a Market Participant in a given OTCBB issue

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: This field will be space filled

Field.Name: Wanted Indicator
Field.Description: The Offer Wanted/Bid Wanted Indicator field indicates a special, unpriced OTCBB quotation from a market participant

Field.Name: Unsolicited Indicator
Field.Description: The Unsolicited Indicator field indicates if the Market Participant is entering an unsolicited quote in a given security

Field.Name: Bid Price Denominator
Field.Description: The Bid Price Denominator denotes the whole dollar and decimal digit composition of the Ask Price field

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: The Bid Price is the price at which the OTCBB quoting participant is willing to buy the security for at a given time

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: The Bid Size represents the amount of shares available at the quoting participant’s Bid Price in the given security

Field.Name: Ask Price Denominator
Field.Description: The Ask Price Denominator denotes the whole dollar and decimal digit composition of the Ask Price field

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: The Ask price is the price at which the quoting participant is willing to sell (offer) the security for at any given time

Field.Name: Ask Size
Field.Description: The Ask Size represents the amount of shares available at the quoting participant’s Ask Price in the given security

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: This field indicates the currency in which the trade transaction was reported

Field.Name: Inside Appendage Indicator
Field.Description: The Inside Appendage Indicator field indicates how the Inside quote for the OTCBB issue is impacted by the current Market Participant update

Message.Name: General Administrative Message
Message.Description: A variable length, free-form text message format will be used on an as-needed basis

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free-form text is used to notify data feed subscribers of corporate actions or special trading situations

Message.Name: Trading Action Message
Message.Description: FINRA will disseminate this message to inform customers of trading actions, such as halts or trading resumptions which affect individual OTCBB or Other OTC securities

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: This alphanumeric field indicates the issue symbol for the OTCBB security that is impacted by the FINRA Trading Action

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: Indicates the current trading status for the stated issue

Field.Name: Reason Code
Field.Description: The Reason Code indicates the reason for the current trading action status.

Message.Name: Start Of Day Message
Message.Description: The Start of Day control message signifies the beginning of each operational cycle for TDDS processing

Message.Name: End Of Day Message
Message.Description: The End of Day control message signals the end of active message dissemination for the TDDS operational cycle

Message.Name: Market Session Open Message
Message.Description: The Market Session Open Control Message signifies the opening of FINRA’s market systems for the session indicated in the Message Header

Message.Name: Market Session Close Message
Message.Description: The Session Close Control Message signals the closing of FINRA’s market systems for the session indicated in the Message Header

Message.Name: End Of Retransmission Requests Message
Message.Description: This message signals that no further retransmission requests will be honored. The End of Retransmission Requests message will be sent three times, at one-minute intervals

Message.Name: End Of Transmissions Message
Message.Description: The End of Transmissions Message signals that there will be no further transmissions of data sent through the TDDS line.

Message.Name: Line Integrity Message
Message.Description: The Line Integrity Control Message will be transmitted at approximately one-minute intervals to verify the operational integrity of the TDDS message transmission, and will be intermixed with other messages

Message.Name: Sequence Number Reset Message
Message.Description: The Sequence Number Reset Message forces the resetting of the Sequence Number. The Sequence Number will either be reset to zero or to a number greater than the last number previously transmitted

Message.Name: End of Trade Reporting Message
Message.Description: The End of Trade Reporting Control Message signals that the ORF system is closed for market participant trade transactions

Field.Name: Session Identifier
Field.Description: This field indicates the market session of the message

Field.Name: Retransmission Requester
Field.Description: This field indicates if the message is an original transmission or retransmission

Field.Name: Message Sequence Number
Field.Description: Message Sequence Number, at the beginning of each operational cycle, this number will be set to 00000000 of each data channel

Field.Name: Market Center Originator ID
Field.Description: This field indicates the market center or system that originated the message that follows

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: This field will be space filled

Field.Name: Year
Field.Description: The year the transaction occurred

Field.Name: Month
Field.Description: The month the transaction occurred

Field.Name: Day
Field.Description: The day of the month the transaction occurred

Field.Name: Hour
Field.Description: The hour of the day the transaction occurred in military time

Field.Name: Minute
Field.Description: The minute of the hour the transaction occurred.

Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: The second of the minute the transaction occurred

Struct.Name: Inside Appendage
Struct.Description: If a quoting participant update impacts the OTCBB Inside Quote for an issue, an OTCBB Inside Appendage will be added to the OTCBB Market Participant Quote Update message

Field.Name: Inside Quote Condition
Field.Description: This Function field denotes if the original trade report is being cancelled or was reported in error

Field.Name: Inside Bid Price Denominator
Field.Description: The Inside Bid Price Denominator field denotes the whole dollar and decimal digit composition of the Inside Ask Price field

Field.Name: Inside Bid Price
Field.Description: The Inside Bid Price indicates the best (highest) bid price available in the OTCBB system for the issue

Field.Name: Inside Bid Size
Field.Description: This Inside Bid Size field indicates the largest size (in round lots) quoted by an OTCBB market participant at the Inside Price in the issue.

Field.Name: Inside Ask Price Denominator
Field.Description: The Inside Ask Price Denominator field denotes the whole dollar and decimal digit composition of the Inside Ask Price field

Field.Name: Inside Ask Price
Field.Description: The Inside Ask Price indicates the best ask price available in the OTCBB system for the issue

Field.Name: Inside Ask Size
Field.Description: This Inside Ask Size field indicates the largest size (in round lots) quoted by an OTCBB market participant at the Inside Price in the issue.

Field.Name: Year
Field.Description: The year the transaction occurred

Field.Name: Month
Field.Description: The month the transaction occurred

Field.Name: Day
Field.Description: The day of the month the transaction occurred

Field.Name: Hour
Field.Description: The hour of the day the transaction occurred in military time

Field.Name: Minute
Field.Description: The minute of the hour the transaction occurred.

Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: The second of the minute the transaction occurred
